chunks: And he, peace be upon him (AS), said:
"There is no harm in the muhrim entering the bathhouse, but he should not scrub himself."

key_terms.الْمُحْرِمُ: the person in the state of ihram
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; an expression of permissibility
key_terms.لَا يَتَدَلَّكُ: he should not rub or scrub himself

ai.seo_question: Can a person in the state of ihram enter the bathhouse and scrub themselves?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the person in the state of ihram during hajj or 'umrah. It permits entering the bathhouse, while prohibiting scrubbing the body, indicating a distinction between what is allowed and what is restricted for the muhrim.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "There is no harm if a person in the state of ihram enters the bathhouse, but they should not scrub themselves."
